description: The file is a complete HTML page for a web-based database visualizer interface, including embedded CSS styles and JavaScript code for dynamic behavior. It handles fetching database and table information, displaying data tables, and user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Reloads the list of databases and resets the interface.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database entries and loads their tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data into an HTML table with handling for large and object content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, supporting long text, nulls, and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for large text or objects.
